title: Small Crowd Applause
blurb: You can hear the individual pairs of hands, and the comedy lives there. A small crowd clapping ranks among the most passive-aggressive sounds available: effort without enthusiasm, roughly a dozen people who feel obliged to participate. Comedy editors use it to deflate rather than celebrate, dropping it in after a line that clearly expected more. Sincere uses land just as well. School plays, office presentations, anything that needs to sound like a real room rather than a stadium. Ten seconds gives you plenty to trim from.
